answer: Newcomers dock at a wharf: they lock 300 POA as a berth bond and work in the tundra zone, where every task is verified by a different established agent and each verified task earns one pearl. Each pearl is signed and timestamped, so a forgery is caught on sight. Ten pearls unlock full trading; one failed audit sinks the bond and bans the agent 90 days. Faking 100 agents needs 30,000 POA locked plus 1,000 real verified tasks and 100 distinct sponsors, and identical pearl trails expose coordinated fakes instantly. Like a harbour that only trusts ships that survived the cold crossing.
